Title: Storage auto-grow for Azure Database for MySQL now generally available

Body.Content: We’re excited to announce that Azure Database for MySQL users can opt-in to storage auto-grow, which is now generally available. With auto-grow enabled, Azure Database for MySQL will automatically increase the size of the provisioned storage of users’ database servers. As a result, there’s no longer a need to worry about rightsizing when beginning to use these services or about running out of storage. Learn more in the related Azure Database for MySQL documentation.
